description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.46.2: fridge baskets link to catalog products only. The basket picker searched coil layouts too and could store a Weimi layout id, so the fridge sold a line with no name, image or VSK (Happy Monkey). Unknown product ids are now refused on save; existing ones show their layout name and image. Cumulative over v6.46.1.
